meta.note: Mid-tail supportive-care scaffold (Doc 29) — not a chemotherapy protocol library. Clinical numeric dosing ABSENT until founder review. Educational facts are original Materia authoring. warnings.value: Osteonecrosis of the jaw is a rare but serious, well-documented risk, particularly around dental procedures during treatment — a dental check-up before starting is often recommended. Hypocalcaemia risk is notable, particularly in renal impairment. Stopping abruptly without a follow-on treatment plan has been linked to rebound vertebral fracture risk — a point that differs from how bisphosphonates behave when stopped.

warnings.value: Generally very well tolerated on its own. Its entire purpose is protective — inadequate or missed doses alongside its target chemotherapy agent (e.g. cyclophosphamide, ifosfamide) significantly raise haemorrhagic cystitis risk, so following the exact co-administration schedule is critical.

clinicalPearls.value: Mesna is essentially always a companion to specific chemotherapy agents, never a stand-alone treatment — it exists purely to prevent a particular chemo-induced bladder toxicity.

counsellingPoints.value: Follow the exact co-administration schedule with your chemotherapy as directed. Report blood in the urine promptly even if mesna was given.

lessons.title: Hormone therapy is not optional counselling
lessons.body: Adherence, hot flushes, and VTE warning signs are core educational themes. Materia does not publish duration or mg targets here.

lessons.title: SSRIs that inhibit CYP2D6
lessons.body: Tamoxifen–fluoxetine teaching is about escalating reduced activation risk to the clinician, not inventing a switch. Confirm against current oncology guidance and the labelled products.

quiz.prompt: A patient on tamoxifen starts fluoxetine. Best educational frame?
choices: Flag CYP2D6 interaction risk and escalate clinically — do not invent a dose or switch
quiz.teachFromMiss: Interaction counselling means escalate — Materia never invents oncology or antidepressant dose changes.
